title: Coach Today — desktop

title: Parent Home — mobile
description: Primary parent-home reference: weekly focus, reviewed update, next session and shortcuts.

description: Original student-facing visual. Current release uses parent-supported practice; this is not approval for independent child accounts.

description: Shared sessions, player focuses and parent preview. Implement batch defaults with optional overrides; approval and sending remain distinct.

title: Parent weekly plan — mobile
description: Weekly sessions and child-specific training focus.

title: Monthly report queue — desktop
description: Draft, review and approved report states. Illustrative statuses only.

description: Parent report layout with summary, development and next steps. Copy is illustrative, not verified performance data.

title: Coach dashboard with session agenda — desktop
description: Secondary coach-home treatment showing an ordered session plan.

title: WhatsApp weekly-plan preview — mobile
description: Visual message layout only. Verification badge, sending and online indicators do not establish a live provider connection.

title: Compact monthly report — portrait
description: Report layout: training focus, reviewed observation and next step. Attendance and other display data are illustrative.

title: Parent Home with fee reminder — mobile
description: Parent-home variation including fees and report/practice shortcuts.

title: Academy payments — desktop
description: Academy training-fee collection overview, player balances and payment requests; not Sportozen subscription billing.

title: Parent academy-fee payment — mobile
description: Proposed fee checkout. Provider and payment method logos are artwork, not a selected or connected integration.

title: WhatsApp monthly-report notification — mobile
description: Monthly report announcement. Production links must use authorised parent access, not permanent public child-report URLs.

title: Practise together — mobile
description: Approved home activity and coaching cue. A parent practice check-in is self-report, not verified improvement.

title: Professional monthly report — full artwork
description: Preserved original layout reference. The 8.2/10, skill ratings, sample progress and QR code are not approved product scoring or live links. Use academy-first branding and real reviewed records.

title: Owner overview — earlier concept
description: Exploratory layout for academy operations. Use the primary visual anchor for final styling; sample metrics are not validated records.

title: Academy setup — earlier concept
description: Academy identity, branches and facilities. Multi-sport elements in this older artwork are outside the current football-only release.

title: Player directory — earlier concept
description: Search, filters, squad roster and player selection. Earlier low-resolution panel.

title: Player development path — earlier concept
description: Visual development stages. Do not implement unexplained percentage completion or talent scoring.

title: Individual development plan — earlier concept
description: Personal focus, weekly training and review criteria. Batch inheritance and optional adjustment are the current product rules.

title: Session builder — earlier concept
description: Selected drills, order and durations. Preserve the newer simplified, one-save workflow.

title: Session personaliser — earlier concept
description: Different player objectives within one shared session; no requirement for separate full plans for every player.

title: Session Desk — earlier concept
description: Agenda, current drill and player focus while coaching.

title: Drills library — earlier concept
description: Activity cards and filters. Drill content must be reviewed and appropriately licensed before use.

title: Drill detail — earlier concept
description: Diagram, objective, instructions and add-to-session action.

title: Attendance — earlier concept
description: Present, absent, excused and unmarked. This was a small panel, not a full-resolution design.

title: Video and evidence library — earlier concept
description: Exploratory video library. AI analysis is Coming soon; visible prototype buttons are not implementation evidence.

title: Evidence viewer — earlier concept
description: Video moment with player, drill and coach review context. Source was a small panel.

title: Communication centre — earlier concept
description: Template and approval exploration; do not treat send controls as working integrations.

title: Academy analytics — earlier concept
description: Operational reporting exploration. Sample charts are not validated live data.

title: Academy settings — earlier concept
description: Settings/navigation exploration, not a complete permissions or onboarding specification.

title: Parent schedule, progress, fees and messages — earlier storyboard
description: Six miniature mobile panels preserved from the original board. Detailed full-size designs have not been approved.
